topic_ko: 춥고 건조한 빙하기에서 따뜻하고 습한 농경 세계로
_note: 원문 유형은 글의 순서(주어진 글→(B)→(A)→(C)). order 유형을 가장 강하게 출제. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: During the Ice Age the planet was not only far colder but also, just as importantly, much drier.
When temperatures fall very low, water evaporates less, fewer clouds form, and far less rain falls.
A cold and dry world made it extremely hard for plants to grow.
In such a climate, depending on a single piece of land for food was simply too risky to attempt.
Then, as the temperature climbed and the ice caps melted, life suddenly burst forth everywhere.
The world grew warmer and wetter, and people began to settle where food could be grown most intensively.
Over thousands of years, hunter-gatherers gradually added farming to their way of life.
choices: why hunting was always more reliable than farming for early humans
how rising heat and moisture turned a barren Ice Age into a farming world
how clouds and rainfall are formed in extremely cold climates
why plants need warm soil more than they need water to grow
how early farmers chose which crops to plant on their land
theme.explanation_ko: 춥고 건조해 농사가 불가능했던 빙하기가, 기온 상승과 빙하 해빙으로 따뜻하고 습해지면서 농경이 가능한 세계로 바뀌었다는 내용. ②가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①사냥의 우월성, ③구름·강우의 형성 원리, ④토양 온도, ⑤작물 선택은 본문의 핵심이 아니다.

passage: We should not picture the entire human past as a single, unchanging stage for farming.
During the Ice Age the world was cold and, because of that cold, surprisingly dry as well.
With little evaporation and rain, plants struggled, and depending on one field for food was too risky.
We must recognize that farming becomes possible only when the climate itself allows it.
As the temperature rose and the ice melted, life exploded and the world turned warmer and wetter.
Only then did people gather where food could be grown most intensively.
We ought to remember that human ways of living are shaped by the climate they are born into.
Farming was not a sudden choice but a gift made possible by a changing world.
choices: 사냥꾼은 농부보다 더 부지런하게 식량을 구해야 한다.
추운 기후일수록 비가 더 많이 내려 농사에 유리하다.
농경은 인류가 의도적으로 선택한 가장 빠른 발전이었다.
인간의 생활 방식은 그 시대의 기후에 의해 결정된다.
한 곳의 땅에만 의존하는 것이 가장 안전한 식량 확보법이다.
claim.explanation_ko: 춥고 건조한 빙하기엔 농사가 불가능했으나 따뜻·습윤해지자 농경이 가능해졌다는 흐름에서, 인간의 생활 방식이 기후에 의해 좌우된다는 것이 주장. ④가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①근면, ②추위와 비, ③의도적 선택, ⑤단일 토지 의존은 본문 주장과 어긋나거나 지엽적이다.

passage: In the Ice Age the earth was not only much colder but also, crucially, much drier.
Deep cold means less evaporation, fewer clouds, and very little rain.
Because the world was cold and dry, plants found it hard to grow.
Under such conditions, trusting one patch of land to feed you was far too dangerous.
But once the temperature rose and the ice melted, life suddenly flourished.
The world became warmer and wetter, and people settled where crops grew best.
Slowly, across many centuries, farming took root alongside hunting and gathering.
choices: 빙하기의 추위는 농작물을 보호하는 이로운 역할을 했다.
사냥과 채집은 농경보다 항상 더 많은 식량을 제공했다.
구름과 비의 양은 토지의 위험성과 무관하다.
기온이 오르고 습해지면서 비로소 농경이 가능한 세계가 열렸다.
인류는 빙하기에도 한곳에 정착해 농사를 지었다.
gist.explanation_ko: 춥고 건조해 식물이 자라기 힘들던 세계가 따뜻하고 습해지면서 농경이 가능해졌다는 것이 요지. ④가 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①추위의 이로움, ②사냥의 우월, ③구름·비, ⑤빙하기 정착 농경은 요지가 아니다.

passage: The Ice Age was a world defined by two harsh facts: bitter cold and stubborn dryness.
When the air is that cold, water barely evaporates, clouds rarely form, and rain seldom falls.
In a cold, dry land, plants struggle, and betting your survival on one field is reckless.
Then the great thaw came: temperatures climbed and the vast ice caps began to melt.
Life exploded across the land, and the world grew both warmer and far wetter.
People drifted toward the places where food could be grown most intensively.
Step by step, over thousands of years, humanity learned to farm.
choices: Why Rain Never Falls When the Weather Turns Cold
Hunting and Gathering: The Safest Way to Survive
From Frozen and Dry to Warm and Wet: The Dawn of Farming
The Ice Age: A Golden Age for Wild Plants
How One Field Can Feed an Entire Village
title.explanation_ko: 춥고 건조한 빙하기에서 따뜻·습윤한 세계로 바뀌며 농경이 시작된 흐름을 압축한 ③이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ①비, ②사냥·채집, ④빙하기 식물, ⑤단일 토지는 글의 초점이 아니다.

passage: The Ice Age was not just cold; the cold itself made the whole world remarkably dry.
With little evaporation and almost no rain, plants could hardly survive at all.
In that climate, leaning on a single field for your food was a gamble no one could afford.
Then the temperature climbed, the ice caps melted, and life suddenly came rushing back.
The world turned warmer and wetter, and at last the doors of farming swung open.
People began to gather where the land could be made to produce food most intensively.
What the climate had once locked away, the warming world finally set free.
implication.underlined: the doors of farming swung open
choices: early people forced the cold land to grow crops by hard work
farmers built actual gates around their fields for protection
the warmer, wetter climate finally made farming possible
hunting was abandoned the moment the ice began to melt
the Ice Age was the true beginning of organized agriculture
implication.explanation_ko: '농경의 문이 열렸다'는 비유는 따뜻하고 습해진 기후가 비로소 농사를 가능하게 했다는 뜻이다. ③이 정답.
implication.distractor_ko: ①노력, ②실제 문, ④사냥 포기, ⑤빙하기 농경은 비유의 의미와 다르다.

passage: During the Ice Age, the planet was not only much colder but also, crucially, much drier.
If it is really cold, there is far less evaporation, little clouds, and less rain.
Our world in the Ice Age was cold and dry, which made it difficult for plants to grow.
In this kind of climate, depending on one piece of land is too risky to be a real option.
As the temperature rose and the ice caps melted, we experienced a sudden explosion of life.
The world got warmer and wetter, and people started to live where they could grow food intensively.
This did not happen overnight; it probably took thousands of years.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
grammar.explanation_ko: ② 가산복수명사 'clouds' 를 수식하려면 'little' 이 아니라 'fewer' 가 와야 한다. 'little' 은 불가산명사에만 쓰이므로 'little clouds' 는 비문이다. ②가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①비교급 drier, ③앞 절 전체를 받는 계속적 관계대명사 which, ④too ~ to 구문의 to부정사 to be, ⑤'As' 절 안에서 the temperature rose 와 등위로 연결되는 과거형 정동사 melted 는 모두 옳다.

passage: During the Ice Age the planet was not only much colder but also, crucially, much drier.
When it is really cold, there is far less evaporation, fewer clouds, and less rain.
Our Ice Age world was cold and dry, so it was easy for plants to grow.
In this climate, farming was not an option, for relying on one field was too risky.
As the temperature rose and the ice caps melted, we saw a sudden explosion of life.
The world became warmer and wetter, and people settled where food could grow intensively.
This change did not happen overnight; it probably took thousands of years.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
vocab.explanation_ko: ③ 빙하기 세계는 춥고 건조해 식물이 자라기 '어려웠다(difficult)'. '쉬웠다(easy)'는 정반대 의미라 부적절하므로 difficult 로 고쳐야 한다. ③이 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①drier(더 건조한), ②evaporation(증발), ④risky(위험한), ⑤explosion(폭발적 증가)은 문맥에 적절하다.

farming simply was not an option
hunting was no longer necessary

people gave up moving from place to place
blank.explanation_ko: 춥고 건조해 식물이 자라기 힘들고 한 땅에 의존하는 것이 위험했으므로, 그런 기후에서는 '농사가 선택지가 될 수 없었다(farming was not an option)'. ②가 정답.
blank.distractor_ko: ①폭우, ③사냥 불필요, ④작물 번성, ⑤정착은 춥고 건조한 흐름과 맞지 않는다.

order.given: During the Ice Age, not only was the planet much colder, with ice sheets covering much of the northern hemisphere, but, crucially, it was much drier.

blocks.A: Our world in the Ice Age was therefore cold and dry, meaning it was difficult for plants to grow. In this type of climate, farming isn't an option: it's too risky to depend on any one piece of land to produce the energy you need.
blocks.B: We often associate the cold with the wet, but if it is really cold, there is far less evaporation, fewer clouds, and less rain.
blocks.C: As the temperature rose and the ice caps melted, we experienced a sudden explosion of life. The world got warmer and wetter, and people started to live around places where they could make food grow most intensively.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글이 '빙하기는 더 건조했다'로 끝나면, (B)가 '추우면 비가 적다'며 그 건조함을 설명하고, (A)가 'therefore' 로 춥고 건조해 농사가 불가능함을 정리하며, (C)가 기온 상승·해빙 이후의 변화를 제시한다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (C)의 기온 상승·습윤화는 (A)의 춥고 건조한 상태 다음의 변화이므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (A)의 'therefore' 는 (B)의 설명을 받아야 한다.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 'But ... 기온이 올라 생명이 폭발했다'로 추위·건조함의 흐름을 뒤집는 전환이다. 농사가 불가능했다는 ④ 다음, 그리고 세상이 따뜻·습윤해졌다는 문장 앞에 와야 한다. ④가 정답.

passage: During the Ice Age the world was both much colder and, because of the cold, much drier.
Little evaporation meant few clouds and very little rain.
In this cold, dry climate plants struggled, and relying on one field for food was far too risky.
Farming, in short, was simply not possible.
But as the temperature rose and the ice melted, life suddenly exploded.
The world grew warmer and wetter, and people settled where crops grew most intensively.
Over thousands of years, humanity gradually turned to farming.
summary.summary_template: Because the Ice Age was cold and __(A)__, farming was impossible, but as the world grew warmer and wetter, people were finally able to __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 빙하기는 춥고 (A)건조(dry)해 농사가 불가능했으나, 따뜻·습윤해지자 사람들이 비로소 (B)농사를 지을(farm) 수 있었다. ②.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 wet/stormy 가 아니라 dry, (B)는 migrate/hunt/rest 가 아니라 farm 이어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.answer: Our world in the Ice Age was cold and dry.
writing.explanation_ko: 주어 Our world + 전치사구 in the Ice Age + be동사 was + 보어 cold and dry.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 기온이 오르면서, 우리는 생명의 갑작스러운 폭발을 경험했다.
writing.answer: As the temperature rose, we experienced a sudden explosion of life.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간의 접속사 As + the temperature rose, 주절 we experienced a sudden explosion of life.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 정말로 추우면, 비가 훨씬 더 적게 내린다.
writing.answer: If it is really cold, there is much less rain.
writing.explanation_ko: 조건절 If it is really cold + 주절 there is much less rain(less + 불가산명사 rain).

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: As the world grew warmer and wetter, people started to ___________ where food could grow most intensively.
writing.explanation_ko: 따뜻하고 습해지자 사람들이 식량이 잘 자라는 곳에 '정착해 살기(live)' 시작했다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: In this type of climate, farming isn't an option: it's too risky to depend on any one piece of land to produce the energy you need.
writing.answer: 이런 종류의 기후에서는 농사가 선택지가 아니다. 당신이 필요로 하는 에너지를 생산하기 위해 어느 한 조각의 땅에 의존하는 것은 너무 위험하다.
writing.explanation_ko: farming isn't an option(농사는 선택지가 아니다), too risky to depend on(의존하기에는 너무 위험한).
